title: Milestone sweep always reports zero created milestones
reasoning: check_participation_milestones calls track_fast_participant_milestone but does not return its boolean result. The daily task assigns that return value to milestone_created and increments milestones_created only when it is truthy, so even when a milestone event is created the task result and logs report zero created milestones.
reproduction: Run check_participation_milestones_task with an active fast whose participant count exactly matches a milestone threshold and has no prior milestone event; the event can be created, but the task returns `milestones_created: 0`.
recommendation: Return the result of track_fast_participant_milestone from check_and_track_participation_milestones, and return False on exceptions.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Included tests cover milestone checks indirectly and admin trigger responses, but do not assert the daily task's returned `milestones_created` count when a threshold is hit.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create an active fast with exactly 10 participants, run check_participation_milestones_task synchronously/eagerly, and assert the returned `milestones_created` is 1 and the milestone event exists.
minimumFixScope: events/signals.py return value plus a focused task regression test.
